addedAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

position.description: Sparse integer ordering within one custom collection. Gaps are allowed so reorder writes can stay bounded.

collection.description: Reference to the custom collection this item belongs to.

catalogTarget.description: The work and edition that this membership item represents. Mutable.

catalogSnapshot.description: Point-in-time catalog metadata for the added work or edition, captured when this record was last written. Refreshed on every update.

main.description: A membership item placing one edition in a custom collection. Duplicate convention: the rkey is a TID minted once at first create and never changes. Several records may exist for one actor and edition (for example from out-of-band writers); consumers SHOULD treat the record with the greatest `addedAt` as the winner and break ties by the lowest TID, ignoring the others. This is a convention, not an enforced contract: AppViews MUST tolerate a differing winner, and may see a record's catalogTarget change over time.

cid.description: Optional content hash (CID) of the owning collection record at the time this reference was written. Informational only; not part of the logical membership identity.

uri.description: AT-URI of the owning social.dracome.library.collection record.

collectionRef.description: A reference to the custom collection (social.dracome.library.collection record) that owns this membership item.
